finalReading.passage: When Ben switched on his new robot for the first time, it simply stood still and said nothing. He almost thought it was broken. Then, in a soft voice, the robot asked how it could help, and Ben smiled with relief.

questions.q: How did the robot behave at first?
options: It stood without moving or speaking.
It ran out of the room.

questions.q: How did Ben feel in the end?
options: Relieved when the robot offered to help.
